claim: Independent ticket-guide vendor recommends the Schönbrunn Grand Tour with audio guide as the best option for most first-time visitors, reserving the Imperial Tour only for time-constrained trips.
quote: Best for most visitors: Grand Tour with audio guide... Book the Grand Tour with audio guide for a first visit. It covers everything meaningful inside the palace and the audio guide is clear.

claim: Second independent travel guide endorses the Grand Tour as the preferred option for first-time visitors interested in history, design, or the full Habsburg story.
quote: If you are interested in Schönbrunn Palace interior design, political history or the full sweep of the Habsburg story, this is the tour to choose and it provides proper context.

claim: Weltmuseum Wien's official Plan Your Visit page lists 2026 opening hours as daily 10 am to 6 pm except Mondays, with Tuesday extended to 9 pm.
quote: Daily (except Monday) 10 am to 6 pm; Tuesday 10 am to 9 pm

claim: Weltmuseum Wien adult ticket is €16, with reduced €12 and free entry under 19; ticket also covers KHM Imperial Armoury and Historic Musical Instruments collection.
quote: Tickets for the Weltmuseum cost €16 for adults, €12 for reduced admission, and are free for children and adolescents under 19.

claim: MAK Vienna opens Tuesday 10:00 to 21:00 (late-night), Wednesday through Sunday 10:00 to 18:00, and is closed Mondays.
MAK Vienna's standard adult admission rate is €15.50.
Wien Museum Karlsplatz opens Tuesday-Friday 09:00-18:00, Thursday until 21:00 (late-night), and Saturday-Sunday 10:00-18:00, with the permanent exhibition free of charge.
quote: Tu, 09:00 - 18:00; We, 09:00 - 18:00; Th, 09:00 - 21:00; Fr, 09:00 - 18:00; Sa, 10:00 - 18:00; Su, 10:00 - 18:00 ... The permanent exhibition is accessible free of charge.

claim: Wien Museum Karlsplatz charges €12 or €8 standard for special exhibitions (€10 or €6 reduced); permanent collection remains free and special exhibitions on the upper floor are free every first Sunday of the month and for under-19s.
quote: Standard ticket price: 12€ or 8€ (depending on the exhibition), with reduced prices of 10€ or 6€ ... free admission to the special exhibitions on the upper floor for all under 19 and every first Sunday of the month.
